scientific_integrity: Classical interpolation remainder and Krylov polynomial exactness are credited. The m=2 sharp positivity horizon was previously established; novelty is assessed only for the all-depth parity and crossing classification. Numerical checks supplement an analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic polynomial symmetric Lanczos, diagonal positive spectrum, strictly positive starting vector, incomplete Krylov spaces only.
Only the largest spectral-coordinate signs (and monotone times for evaluation points above the Ritz range) are classified; no full-coordinate odd-depth positivity is asserted.
No finite-precision, non-diagonal positive-system or rational Krylov theorem is established.
title: Parity and the unique extreme-mode sign transition in incomplete Lanczos exponentials
